clause: Unified export surfaces I — single-target, export-for-screens/slices, legacy web optimizer [STU-IO-010]

scope.summary: Implement the first StudioExportRecipe surface group (one primitive, many recipes, NO separate per-surface subsystem): single-target export (per-document, per-layer, per-artboard — deduped Export As / Save a Copy) plus a one-click Quick Export default with preferred format+location; export-for-screens/slices (independent named regions from areas/layers/artboards, each with its own format+scale set; multi-scale 1x/2x/3x with scale-suffix filename tokens; continuous/automatic re-export when slice content changes); and the legacy web optimizer (2-up/4-up preview, GIF/JPEG/PNG-8/PNG-24 settings, dither, transparency matte, color-table editing, image-size, slice-aware HTML/image output). Export area MUST resolve against the canonical document/selection/slice set, NOT the currently rendered/visible subset.
acceptance_criteria: single-target + screens/slices + web optimizer as StudioExportRecipe on canonical set; Argus + manual
expected_tests: test: per-document/layer/artboard + Quick Export; slices with per-region format/scale + scale-suffix tokens + auto re-export
test: export area resolves against canonical set, not visible subset; web-optimizer 2-up/4-up + color-table

target_entries: Studio / Import & Export / Export surfaces — single, screens & web

risk_if_missed: No export surfaces; per-surface subsystem fork; visible-subset export bug.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
